title: Pretty but...
text: Pretty but.... These are not good for kitchen towels. They start to bunch up after the first wash. I use them as rags and they are pretty for that vs white rags

product_metadata.title: COTTON CRAFT 12 Pack Multicolor Kitchen Towels 16x28 Inches- Pure Cotton, Absorbent Waffle Weave
features: SET CONTENTS: Each set includes twelve (12) COTTON CRAFT Waffle Weave Kitchen Towels in assorted colors, each measuring 16 inches by 28 inches (16"x28")
STYLISH & FUNCTIONAL: Keep COTTON CRAFT's kitchen towels handy in your home for washing, drying and tackling any kitchen messes
VIBRANT COLORS: An assortment of bold colors will always brighten your day (and your kitchen!)
ECO-FRIENDLY: Go green and replace your single-use paper towels with 100% pure cotton kitchen towels, made from all-natural fibers

EASY CARE: All COTTON CRAFT kitchen towels/tea towels/dishcloths are easy care. Machine wash on gentle cycle to reduce the possibility of shrinkage. Tumble dry low. NOTE: Due to the nature of the cotton fabric, some minimal shrinkage may occur.
